description: The Grounds Coordinator keeps GNGRLL's fields safe, playable, and improving across the year, covering Douglas, Penney, Pennell, Newbegin, Intervale, Russell, and Raymond-area sites. Responsibilities span seasonal cleanups, mowing and dragging, base paths, mounds and batter's boxes, fertilizer and aeration, and grounds equipment (mowers, tractors, drags, sheds). This role also drives capital field projects such as batting cages, 50/70 conversions, dugout/fencing improvements (Intervale), and infield-mix work, often recruiting volunteers for scheduled field work days.

calendar.title: End-of-season field cleanup priorities by field
calendar.description: Set fall cleanup and maintenance priorities per field: fencing, base paths, mounds, dugouts, drag, aerate/fertilize. Review at the fall board meeting.

calendar.title: Fall field improvement/planning projects review
calendar.description: Plan fall field improvement projects: Intervale, Bennett Rd, Douglass, lights, batting cages, and 50/70 conversions.

calendar.description: Purchase fall fertilizer and schedule aeration for fields (recurring fertilizer authorization up to ~$300 for Douglas/Penney).

calendar.title: Fall field maintenance & equipment planning
calendar.description: Review fall maintenance and planning: fertilizer, field conversions, and grounds equipment (mowers, sheds).

calendar.title: Douglass field improvements review

calendar.title: End-of-season fields wrap-up: banners/cages, clean fields

calendar.title: Field maintenance/improvement & grounds equipment planning

calendar.description: Update on field conversion and improvement projects: Fenway wall, Intervale, batting cages, and field strips.

tasks.title: Compile end-of-season field cleanup priority list
